title: Local inference: the plug call carries the weights core resolved for the selected model
goal: Owed from T-NOFAKES-1: core sending the chosen model to the local engine. Core already sent selected_model (the id) on gpu_fabric.local_engine.infer_stream, but the commercial plug resolves ids differently (exact file name in its own data dir, no .gguf stem match, no SUSI_MODEL_DIR), so a model core selected and loaded could be 'not found' in the plug. The builtin plug now also sends model_path, the file core's ModelManager resolved for selected_model (additive; older plugs ignore it). The unreachable duplicate bus call in SusiGgufEngine is removed (local_engine_plug() is Some whenever that topic is wired), so susi-gemi shrinks. Commercial counterpart: susi-commercial-apps T-MODELPICK-1.
limitations: The live check reaches the commercial license admission and stops there (the test weights carry no publisher receipt); no tokens were generated.
With a plug host older than commercial T-MODELPICK-1 the extra model_path field is ignored and the old exact-name lookup applies.
results: Gap confirmed by reading code: core already sent selected_model on gpu_fabric.local_engine.infer_stream (GEMI /v1/chat/completions model -> reason_internal requested_model -> infer_via_contract model_hint -> SusiGgufEngine -> BuiltinLocalEnginePlug -> bus), but no resolved weights; the commercial plug resolved ids only as an exact file name in its own data dir, so core's stem-matched <id>.gguf / SUSI_MODEL_DIR model was not found there.

tests/local_plug_carries_selected_model.rs drives infer_via_contract against a recording bus handler: fails on origin/main (payload had no model_path), passes with the change (selected_model and model_path = SUSI_MODEL_DIR/tiny-chosen.gguf, decoy tiny-chosen-decoy.gguf not picked).

cargo test -p susi-gemi: lib 438 passed, bin 4, local_plug_carries_selected_model 1, native_fallback_runs_no_engine 1, openrouter_provider 1, 0 failed. Guards: architecture_tests 43, core_docs_promise 5, lean_core_ceilings 2, orphan_sources 3, 0 failed. fmt clean; workspace clippy --all-targets -D warnings exit 0.
susi-gemi shipped lines 21,274 -> 21,263 (ceiling 21,290 unchanged): the unreachable duplicate bus call in SusiGgufEngine was removed.

Live (isolated SUSI_HOME, SUSI_PORT_OFFSET=700, provider keys unset, this worktree's susi + commercial modelpick susi-plug-host): POST :9791/v1/chat/completions model tiny-chosen -> daemon log 'Local engine failed: ... local engine could not serve model 'tiny-chosen': ... [MODEL LICENSE] Offline admission needs an authenticated receipt'; plug host 'gpu_fabric.local_engine.infer_stream -> err'. The plug resolved and refused exactly the named model.
